summary: Maps the AI difficulty slider value (dword_7D01A0) to a scalar. If the slider is >= 95, returns 1.0 directly (maximum ability); otherwise returns a linear interpolation (double)(dword_7D01A0 - 70) * 0.039999999 * 0.25 + 0.75, spanning roughly 0.75 to below 1.0.

operations.description: Guard: if dword_7D01A0 is >= 95, take the early-return path with the flat maximum scalar.
Return 1.0 when the difficulty slider is at or above 95.
Return the computed scalar when the slider is below 95.
